name: Sierra de Andía megaliths
data: Government of Navarre 2 m ground model
published: Navarre's register of protected cultural heritage (Bien de Interés Cultural) lists 11 dolmens and burial mounds here, published through IDENA. Mounds worn low by grazing may barely show in a 2 m ground model.

sources.cite: Gobierno de Navarra, Registro de Bienes del Patrimonio Cultural de Navarra, archaeological sites layer (PATRIM_Sym_BICarqueo) on IDENA
Gobierno de Navarra, Registro de Bienes del Patrimonio Cultural de Navarra
